boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Austin College

cards.title: The Pouch Club
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Social Hub
cards.notes: Located in the Wright Campus Center, this snack bar serves burgers and quesadillas until 11 PM on weeknights for students using Hopper Dollars.

cards.title: Whataburger

cards.title: IHOP

cards.title: Taco Bell

cards.title: Denny's

cards.title: Casey's

cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store and pizzeria offering late-night food options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Casey's at 3021 N Highway 75 in Sherman is open 24/7 for pickup and delivery.
cards.source_title: 3021 N Highway 75 - Pizza Delivery and Pickup in Sherman, TX | Casey's

cards.title: QuikTrip
cards.subtitle: Reliable 24-Hour Kitchen

cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store with a dedicated kitchen for fresh food items.
cards.evidence_claim: The QuikTrip at 2801 Texoma Pkwy in Sherman is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: QuikTrip Location in Sherman
cards.access_notes: Store open 24 hours; kitchen hours may vary but typically open until 10 PM.

cards.title: McDonald's
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Fast Food
cards.notes: A standard late-night destination on Texoma Parkway, providing consistent fast-food options for students until 11 PM daily.
cards.short_summary: A familiar fast-food chain providing late-night dining and drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 2217 Texoma Pkwy N is open until 11:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: Sherman, Texas McDonald's Locations
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM daily.

cards.title: Hopper Store
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Convenience
cards.notes: Located within the Wright Campus Center, this store allows students to use Hopper Dollars for late-night snacks and essentials.
cards.short_summary: The on-campus convenience store for Austin College students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hopper Store is one of the on-campus venues where students can use Hopper Dollars for snacks and late-night dining.
cards.source_title: Dining - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Hours typically align with the Wright Campus Center operating schedule.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the specific study nooks, social hubs, and quiet retreats that define daily life for Austin College students beyond the standard admissions route.

cards.title: The All-Night Study Hub
cards.subtitle: Abell Library Center
cards.notes: Access this secure 24-hour space for late-night finals prep. It remains open for students even after the main library floors close for the evening.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated 24-hour study facility located within the Abell Library Center for late-night academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Abell Library features a 24-hour study room accessible to students.
cards.source_title: Abell Library | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours for students with valid ID; located on the first floor.

cards.title: Late Night Social Lounge
cards.subtitle: Wright Campus Center
cards.notes: Head here for billiards, ping pong, or a late-night snack. It is the primary social hangout for students after the dining hall closes.
cards.short_summary: A student recreational space in the Wright Campus Center featuring games and late-night dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pouch Club offers recreational space and late-night snacks until 11:00 PM Sunday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: The Pouch Club | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM most nights; located on the first floor of the WCC.

cards.title: The Outdoor Living Room
cards.subtitle: North of Wright Campus Center
cards.notes: Use the outdoor power outlets and Wi-Fi to study under the pecan tree. The artificial turf makes it a reliable spot for lounging year-round.
cards.short_summary: A central outdoor gathering space featuring artificial turf, bistro lights, and integrated power outlets for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commons features a pergola, bistro lights, and electrical outlets throughout for student gathering and lounging.
cards.source_title: The Austin College Commons | Details
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space; integrated power and Wi-Fi available.

cards.title: The Silent Study Zone
cards.subtitle: Abell Library Center
cards.notes: Retreat to the second floor for absolute silence. This floor is strictly designated for quiet study, away from the collaborative buzz of the lobby.
cards.short_summary: The designated quiet study floor of the Abell Library, preferred for focused individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: Quiet study is accommodated on the second floor of Abell Library.
cards.source_title: Abell Library | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; accessible via elevator or stairs.

cards.title: The Celebration Fountain
cards.subtitle: Near IDEA Center
cards.notes: Gather at the brick tiers of this amphitheater-style fountain. It is a traditional spot for student celebrations and outdoor relaxation between classes.
cards.short_summary: A landmark campus fountain and plaza used for student gatherings and traditional celebrations.
cards.evidence_claim: Jonsson Fountain features an amphitheatre design with brick tiers where students gather.
cards.source_title: A Tradition Restored | Austin College Magazine
cards.access_notes: Outdoor plaza accessible 24/7.

cards.title: The Modern Science Nook
cards.subtitle: 1108 E. Richards St.
cards.notes: Find a spot in the multi-disciplinary atrium for a high-tech study environment. The building offers 16 lecture rooms and numerous collaborative spaces.
cards.short_summary: A 103,000-square-foot science facility with modern classrooms and collaborative research spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The IDEA Center includes contemporary classrooms and multi-purpose laboratories for student research and study.
cards.source_title: IDEA Center | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; keycard access may be required after hours.

cards.title: The Reflection Garden
cards.subtitle: Between Wortham Center and Wynne Chapel
cards.notes: Visit this quiet court for a moment of reflection. The surrounding walls list the names of every Austin College graduate since 1849.
cards.short_summary: A quiet courtyard and garden featuring the names of all Austin College graduates on its walls.
cards.evidence_claim: The O'Day Honors Court offers a place of quiet reflection and lists the names of all Austin College graduates.
cards.source_title: O'Day Honors Court | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space accessible during daylight hours.

cards.title: The Creative Thoroughfare
cards.subtitle: North Campus
cards.notes: Walk through the shared central outdoor gathering place between the two art buildings. It serves as a scenic thoroughfare for students on the north edge of campus.
cards.short_summary: An art complex featuring a central outdoor gathering space and specialized studios for sculpture and painting.
cards.evidence_claim: The Forster Art Studio Complex buildings are sited to create a shared central outdoor gathering place.
cards.source_title: Forster Art Studio Complex | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor gathering area is accessible; studio access is limited to art students.

cards.title: The Morning Fuel Stop
cards.subtitle: Wright Campus Center
cards.notes: Grab a coffee and find a table in the WCC lobby. It is the go-to spot for a quick caffeine fix and informal morning study sessions.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus coffee shop located in the Wright Campus Center lobby.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kangaroo Coffee Shop is a dining location on campus providing fuel for students.
cards.source_title: Campus Life at Austin College | Sherman, TX
cards.access_notes: Open during daytime hours; located on the first floor of the WCC.

cards.title: The Intimate Sanctuary
cards.subtitle: Inside Wynne Chapel
cards.notes: Find this smaller chapel inside the main Wynne Chapel building for a quieter, more intimate space for meditation or small group worship.
cards.short_summary: A smaller, intimate chapel located within the larger Wynne Chapel complex for religious life activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Sallie Majors Chapel is a smaller chapel space used for Sunday evening communion and spiritual traditions.
cards.source_title: Religious Life - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during chapel hours and for scheduled services.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore the best free social and study spots at Austin College, from serene prairie restorations to vibrant campus galleries and community parks.

cards.title: Lounge at the Commons
cards.subtitle: Outdoor gathering space with artificial turf
cards.notes: Relax under the sprawling pecan tree on the artificial turf lawn. This central hub features bistro lights, WIFI, and electrical outlets for outdoor study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A central campus outdoor lounge area with turf and amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Austin College Commons is a prime gathering space with artificial turf, WIFI, and electrical outlets available for student use year-round.
cards.source_title: The Austin College Commons | Details
cards.access_notes: Open to the public and students for informal gathering and lounging.

cards.title: Hike the Sneed Prairie
cards.subtitle: 100-acre environmental research area
cards.notes: Explore 100 acres of restored Blackland Prairie. It serves as a field laboratory where you can observe native grasses and local wildlife in a natural habitat.
cards.short_summary: A large-scale prairie restoration site used for research and education.
cards.evidence_claim: Austin College maintains the 100-acre Sneed Prairie Restoration as a field laboratory for students and the community.
cards.source_title: Sneed Prairie Restoration | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Accessible for educational purposes and field trips; check for public event dates.

cards.title: Watch the Solar Noon
cards.subtitle: Science center with a gnomonhole
cards.notes: Visit the atrium to see the 'gnomonhole' direct sunlight onto the floor markers. The building also houses a domed observatory and a decorative pond.
cards.short_summary: A modern science facility featuring astronomical markers and public events.
cards.evidence_claim: The IDEA Center features a gnomonhole that directs light onto the atrium floor and hosts free public events for the equinox.
cards.source_title: IDEA Center | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Public invited for specific astronomical events; building open during academic hours.

cards.title: Gather by the Fireplace
cards.subtitle: The campus 'living room'
cards.notes: Meet friends in the two-story atrium featuring a double-faced fireplace. It serves as a central social space with comfortable seating and a speaker's balcony.
cards.short_summary: A large social hub and 'living room' for the Austin College community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wright Campus Center atrium is described as a striking living room with a double-faced fireplace for students and visitors.
cards.source_title: Wright Campus Center | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Open to students and visitors; houses dining and student services.

cards.title: Study Late at Abell
cards.subtitle: Round-the-clock academic space
cards.notes: Utilize the 24-hour study room for late-night projects. The library also features quiet study zones on the second floor and group spaces on the first.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated 24-hour study space within the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Abell Library includes a 24-hour study room and provides quiet study areas on the second floor.
cards.source_title: Abell Library | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: 24-hour study room available for students; general library hours apply to other floors.

cards.title: View Student Exhibits
cards.subtitle: Wilma and Terence Dennis Gallery
cards.notes: Browse rotating exhibitions in the Dennis and Ross galleries. These spaces showcase professional, faculty, and student artwork throughout the academic year.
cards.short_summary: Art galleries within the Forster complex featuring diverse exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Forster Art Studio Complex includes the Dennis Gallery and Ross Student Gallery, which are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Galleries and Exhibits - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Galleries are free and open to the public during exhibition dates.

cards.entity_name: Sally and Jim Nation Learning Commons
cards.title: Collaborate at Ida Green
cards.subtitle: Modern study hub in Ida Green
cards.notes: Work on group projects in this renovated learning space. It is a popular study hub located on the first floor of the Ida Green Communication Center.
cards.short_summary: A renovated, collaborative study space in the communication center.
cards.evidence_claim: The first floor of the Ida Green Communication Center was renovated into the Sally and Jim Nation Learning Commons, a popular study hub.
cards.source_title: Ida Green Communication Center | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Open to students for study and group meetings.

cards.title: Explore Pickens Lake
cards.subtitle: City park with nature trails
cards.notes: Hike the 1.5-mile trail system around Pickens Lake. This serene park offers fishing, mountain biking, and a popular hill for sledding during rare snowfalls.
cards.short_summary: A large city park near campus with a lake and extensive trails.
cards.evidence_claim: Herman Baker Park features Pickens Lake and a 1.5-mile natural trail system, offering free recreational activities.
cards.source_title: Herman Baker Park – Sherman Parks & Rec
cards.access_notes: Public city park; open daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Track the Seasons
cards.subtitle: Pink granite scientific landmark
cards.notes: Observe the shadow fall over metal bars on this pink granite sculpture to mark the change of seasons. It is a quintessential liberal arts landmark on campus.
cards.short_summary: A scientific and artistic sculpture that tracks the seasonal solstices.
cards.evidence_claim: The Solstice Calendar is a campus landmark made of Texas pink granite that marks each season's solstice with shadows.
cards.source_title: Campus Life at Austin College | Sherman, TX
cards.access_notes: Located outdoors on campus; accessible to the public 24/7.

cards.title: Cool Off at Hawn Park
cards.subtitle: Free community water play area
cards.notes: Activate the geysers and sprayers by bumping the red column. This free water play area is a great spot to cool off during hot Texas afternoons.
cards.short_summary: A free public spray ground with geysers and water features.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spray Ground at Hawn Park is a free water ground for the community to play, featuring tumble buckets and geysers.
cards.source_title: Explore the Great Outdoors in Sherman, Texas!
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; seasonal operation.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: From the quiet stacks of Abell Library to the modern labs of the IDEA Center, Austin College offers a variety of environments for focused research and collaborative group work.

cards.title: Quiet Zone Stacks
cards.subtitle: Abell Library Center
cards.notes: Head to the second floor for designated quiet study. This level features individual carrels and tables tucked among the physical collection of over 350,000 titles.
cards.short_summary: The designated quiet study floor of the main campus library, featuring individual desks and book stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Quiet study is accommodated on the second floor, while the first floor provides space for groups to collaborate.
cards.source_title: Abell Library | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; check the LibCal for current daily schedules.

cards.title: The All-Nighter Suite
cards.subtitle: Abell Library Center
cards.notes: Access this dedicated room for late-night sessions when the main library is closed. It provides a secure, well-lit environment for students needing 24/7 workspace.
cards.short_summary: A secure study room within the Abell Library complex that remains open 24 hours a day for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: Also located in the library: ... a 24-hour study room.
cards.source_title: Abell Library | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Available 24 hours a day; student ID may be required for entry during late-night hours.

cards.title: Sunlit Science Hub
cards.subtitle: IDEA Center

cards.evidence_claim: The building features 32 laboratory classrooms... and the domed Adams Observatory... the building's 'gnomonhole' directed light on to the atrium floor.
cards.source_title: IDEA Center | Details - Austin College

cards.title: The Campus Living Room
cards.subtitle: Wright Campus Center

cards.evidence_claim: The two-story atrium creates a striking living room, with a double-faced fireplace and a speaker's balcony.

cards.entity_name: Sally and Jim Nation Learning Commons
cards.title: The Media Hub
cards.subtitle: Ida Green Communication Center

cards.short_summary: A modern learning commons located on the first floor of the Ida Green Communication Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The first floor was renovated to create the Sally and Jim Nation Learning Commons, a popular study hub on campus.
cards.source_title: Ida Green Communication Center | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; used for classes, lectures, and group meetings.

cards.title: Outdoor Tech Lawn
cards.subtitle: North of Wright Campus Center
cards.notes: Study under the pecan tree on artificial turf. This outdoor space is equipped with WiFi and electrical outlets throughout for laptop-friendly sessions.
cards.short_summary: A renovated outdoor gathering space with WiFi and power outlets, ideal for open-air studying.
cards.evidence_claim: WIFI and electrical outlets throughout... make the space accessible... a favorite for informal outdoor gathering and lounging.
cards.source_title: The Austin College Commons | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; features bistro lights and a pergola for evening study.

cards.title: Social Science Nook
cards.subtitle: Hopkins Social Science Center
cards.notes: Find seating near the iconic spiral staircase in this former library building. It offers a quiet, academic atmosphere for social science majors.
cards.short_summary: Study areas located within the Hopkins Center, featuring a historic spiral staircase and seminar rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Spiral Staircase in Hopkins Social Sciences Center... serves as a classroom and office building for the Social Sciences Division.
cards.source_title: Hopkins Center | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Open during academic hours; contains classrooms and seminar rooms.

cards.title: Crimson Chair Retreat
cards.subtitle: Windsor Mall
cards.notes: Grab one of the signature red Adirondack chairs along Windsor Mall for a relaxed reading session. These chairs are a staple for outdoor student life.
cards.short_summary: Signature red outdoor seating located along the Windsor Mall for casual study and reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: The addition of crimson Adirondack chairs along Windsor Mall have revived the heart of campus as a place to study.
cards.source_title: Austin College Traditions | Austin College Magazine
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public seating; available 24/7 weather permitting.

cards.title: Victorian Seminar Rooms
cards.subtitle: Thompson House
cards.notes: Study in a historic 1895 Victorian home. The center includes period reception and seminar rooms equipped with modern technology for education students.
cards.short_summary: A historic home converted into a learning center with seminar rooms and state-of-the-art classrooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The Victorian home includes period reception and seminar rooms, modern offices, and state-of-the-art classrooms.
cards.source_title: Temple Learning Center | Details - Austin College

cards.short_summary: A reservable group study room on the second floor of Abell Library equipped with collaborative tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 223 (Abell Library: 2nd Floor) Capacity: 4. Description: White Board. Dry Erase Markers.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Study Room 223 - LibCal - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Reservable online via LibCal; prioritized for groups of up to 4 people.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and long-standing customs that define the 'Roo spirit at Texas's oldest private college operating under its original charter.

cards.title: The Legend of the 'Roo
cards.subtitle: A mascot born from 19th-century mock trials
cards.notes: Adopted in 1913, the mascot stems from 'Kangaroo Kourt' mock trials held for freshmen. It is one of the most unique mascots in American collegiate sports.
cards.short_summary: The Kangaroo mascot originated from 19th-century student mock trials known as Kangaroo Kourt.
cards.evidence_claim: The mascot was born in the fall of 1913, linked to 'Kangaroo Kourt' mock trials where upperclassmen quizzed freshmen.
cards.source_title: Origin Story: The history of the Kangaroo Mascot - Roo Nation
cards.access_notes: Visible at athletic events and campus spirit rallies throughout the academic year.

cards.title: The Birthday Fountain Dunk
cards.subtitle: A midnight plunge to celebrate another year
cards.notes: Students celebrate birthdays by being 'dunked' in the Margaret Jonsson Fountain at midnight by their friends, a rite of passage for many 'Roos.
cards.short_summary: A student tradition involving a midnight dunk in the campus fountain to celebrate birthdays.
cards.evidence_claim: To celebrate your birthday, your friends may dunk you in the Jonsson Plaza Fountain at midnight.
cards.source_title: Campus Life at Austin College | Sherman, TX
cards.access_notes: The fountain is located in the Jonsson Plaza at the west end of Windsor Mall.

cards.title: The JanTerm Adventure
cards.subtitle: Three weeks, one class, infinite possibilities
cards.notes: Every January, students take exactly one intensive course, often involving international travel or unique on-campus subjects like wine-making chemistry.
cards.short_summary: An intensive three-week academic term in January focused on a single immersive course.
cards.evidence_claim: JanTerm gives students three weeks every January to focus on one class, including travel abroad or unique on-campus courses.
cards.source_title: JanTerm Experience at Austin College | Sherman, TX
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually during the month of January for all enrolled students.

cards.title: The Gown Tradition
cards.subtitle: Seniors and freshmen in full academic regalia
cards.notes: At the start of the year, both incoming freshmen and graduating seniors wear academic gowns to the Opening Convocation in Wynne Chapel.
cards.short_summary: A formal ceremony where freshmen and seniors wear academic regalia to mark the start of the year.
cards.evidence_claim: Opening Convocation is intended for the senior class and incoming first-year students, who wear academic regalia for the service.
cards.source_title: August 2024 Edition | News - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Held annually in late August at Wynne Chapel.

cards.title: The Challenge Coin Tradition
cards.subtitle: Commemorating the choice of major
cards.notes: Sophomores receive a special Austin College challenge coin when they officially declare their major, a physical token of their academic commitment.
cards.short_summary: A tradition where students receive a challenge coin upon declaring their academic major.
cards.evidence_claim: Declaration Day is commemorated with an Austin College challenge coin given to sophomores and transfer students.
cards.source_title: Austin College Traditions | Austin College Magazine
cards.access_notes: Held annually in April for sophomores and transfer students.

cards.title: The Senior Toast
cards.subtitle: Kicking off the final year
cards.notes: Immediately following Opening Convocation, seniors gather for a traditional toast to celebrate the start of their final year at the college.
cards.short_summary: A celebratory toast for the senior class held at the beginning of the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: The senior class is dismissed from Convocation to go directly to the traditional Senior Toast.
cards.source_title: August 2024 Edition | News - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Reserved for the graduating senior class following the fall convocation.

cards.title: The Sound of the Pipes
cards.subtitle: A Scottish-Irish tribute to heritage
cards.notes: Bagpipers lead the academic procession at both Opening Convocation and Commencement, honoring the college's Presbyterian and Scots-Irish roots.
cards.short_summary: The use of bagpipers to lead academic processions during major college ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: A favorite tradition at Commencement is the inclusion of bagpipers as part of the processional.
cards.source_title: Austin College Traditions | Austin College Magazine
cards.access_notes: Heard during the processional and recessional of major academic ceremonies.

cards.title: Monte Carlo Night
cards.subtitle: A high-stakes welcome for freshmen
cards.notes: A signature orientation event where first-year students enjoy a casino-themed evening with play money to build community and meet classmates.
cards.short_summary: A casino-themed social event held for first-year students during orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: Monte Carlo night is an opening-of-school event reserved for first-year students.
cards.source_title: Austin College Traditions | Austin College Magazine
cards.access_notes: Typically held in the Wright Campus Center during the first week of the fall semester.

cards.title: The Kappa Fountain
cards.subtitle: A gift from the first women of AC
cards.notes: Donated in 1924 by the Kappa Gamma Chi sorority to mark the college's 75th anniversary, this fountain remains a central landmark for student life.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus fountain donated by the college's first women's organization.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Kappa Fountain' was the gift of Kappa Gamma Chi Literary Society, dedicated in 1924 for the college's 75th anniversary.
cards.source_title: A Date with Destiny | Austin College Magazine
cards.access_notes: Located between Clyce Hall and the Hopkins Center on the campus grounds.

cards.title: Great Day of Service
cards.subtitle: A campus-wide commitment to Sherman
cards.notes: Hundreds of students, faculty, and staff spend a Saturday volunteering at dozens of local agencies, reinforcing the college's mission of service.
cards.short_summary: An annual day of community service involving the entire college community.
cards.evidence_claim: Great Day of Service involves several hundred students volunteering at more than 40 agencies in the north Texas region.
cards.source_title: College Hosts 'Roo Bound Program for Children
cards.access_notes: Held annually, typically on a Saturday in November.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Austin College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Check In at Mabee Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning Arrival
cards.notes: Start your weekend by picking up orientation materials and your ID at the Wright Campus Center. This is the central hub for all new student information.
cards.short_summary: The primary check-in point for new students to receive orientation packets and IDs.
cards.evidence_claim: New student check-in and information pickup occurs at the Wright Campus Center, Mabee Hall, from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM on the first Friday of orientation.
cards.source_title: First-Year Students Fall 2026 Orientation Schedule - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Open to new students and families during scheduled orientation hours.

cards.title: Stock Up on Essentials
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Errands
cards.notes: Visit the first floor of the Wright Campus Center to grab snacks and room essentials using your newly activated Hopper Dollars.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus convenience store for snacks, beverages, and sundry items.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hopper Store, located on the first floor of the Wright Campus Center, sells snacks and sundries and accepts Hopper Dollars.
cards.source_title: Kangaroo Coffee Company & Hopper Store | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Standard weekday hours are typically 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

cards.title: The Freshman Class Photo
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Tradition
cards.notes: Join your peers at the fountains for the traditional class photo. It is one of the first official group activities for the incoming class.
cards.short_summary: A campus landmark used for the traditional freshman class group photograph.
cards.evidence_claim: The freshman class photo is a tradition held at the Williams Graduation Fountains on the Saturday morning of orientation weekend.
cards.source_title: First-Year Students Fall 2026 Orientation Schedule - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public space; photo event is scheduled for 8:45 AM.

cards.title: First Meal at the Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Saturday Lunch Break
cards.notes: Head to the Wright Campus Center Dining Hall to use your meal plan for the first time and meet other students in a casual setting.
cards.short_summary: The main campus dining hall offering all-you-care-to-eat meals.
cards.evidence_claim: The main dining hall, known as 'The Caf,' is located in the Wright Campus Center and serves lunch from noon to 1:00 PM on orientation Saturday.
cards.source_title: Dining - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Requires a meal plan swipe or cash/credit payment.

cards.title: New 'Roo Evening on the Green
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Social
cards.notes: Gather on the central campus lawn for an evening of community activities designed to help new students bond before classes start.
cards.short_summary: The central lawn of the campus used for major outdoor student social events.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'New Roo Evening on the Green' is a scheduled orientation event held on the College Green from 8:00 PM to 10:00 PM on Saturday.
cards.source_title: First-Year Students Fall 2026 Orientation Schedule - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space; event is specific to new students.

cards.title: Orientation in Nation Theatre
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Session
cards.notes: Attend the 'Belongingness and Community' session to learn about the values and expectations of the Austin College community.
cards.short_summary: A campus facility housing the Nation Theatre, used for orientation presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: Orientation sessions such as 'Belongingness and Community' are held in the Ida Green-Nation Theatre on Sunday morning.
cards.source_title: First-Year Students Fall 2026 Orientation Schedule - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Indoor theatre; access during scheduled orientation sessions.

cards.title: Caffeine Kick at the WCC
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon Recharge
cards.notes: Grab a specialty coffee or tea at this student-favorite spot in the Wright Campus Center while reviewing your class schedule.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus coffee shop located within the Wright Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Kangaroo Coffee Co. is located inside the Wright Campus Center and offers coffee and snacks for students.
cards.source_title: Dining - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Open during regular campus dining hours; accepts Hopper Dollars.

cards.title: Locate the 24-Hour Study Room
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening Prep
cards.notes: Find the 24-hour study space in the library so you know where to go for late-night academic work throughout the semester.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library featuring a dedicated 24-hour study area for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Abell Library includes a 24-hour study room available for student use.
cards.source_title: Abell Library | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: 24-hour access available for the dedicated study room with student ID.

cards.title: Evening Walk at Zauk Circle
cards.subtitle: Sunday Night Reflection
cards.notes: Take a quiet walk through the Zauk Circle drive and garden to appreciate the campus landmarks before the first day of classes.
cards.short_summary: A scenic circle drive and garden entrance to the Austin College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Zauk Circle is a drive and garden area that serves as a prominent entrance to the college campus.
cards.source_title: Zauk Circle | Details - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space accessible at all times.

cards.title: Opening Convocation
cards.subtitle: Monday Morning Kickoff
cards.notes: Attend the formal ceremony that officially opens the academic year. It is a key tradition featuring faculty in full academic regalia.
cards.short_summary: The official ceremony marking the start of the new academic year for all students.
cards.evidence_claim: Opening Convocation is held on the Monday before classes begin to kick off the new academic year.
cards.source_title: Academic Calendar - Austin College
cards.access_notes: Formal event; check the orientation schedule for exact morning start time.
